name: Pegasus
description: The Winged Horse dominates the northern-hemisphere autumn sky. Its four brightest stars form the Great Square of Pegasus, a prominent asterism that serves as a landmark for navigating the autumn sky. The constellation contains HR 8799, a young star with four directly imaged giant planets.
funFact: HR 8799 hosts four confirmed planets detected directly in infrared images — the largest number of directly imaged exoplanets in any single system. All four are gas giants 5–7 times Jupiter's mass, orbiting at vast distances in a system that resembles a scaled-up version of our outer Solar System.
